title: DataTable
description: Data-driven Fiori table from TanStack Table column definitions: sorting via header menu or click, selection, popin, growing and row virtualization.

usage.summary: Render data-driven responsive tables with TanStack columns, sorting and optional row virtualization.
useWhen: Define repeated business rows with data and columns; provide getRowId when selection needs stable keys.
Offer column sorting with sortTrigger="menu" or "click" and control it with sorting and onSortingChange when needed.
Render a large flat row set with virtualize, a fixed rowHeight and virtualHeight; use overflowMode="popin" for narrower screens.

avoidWhen.when: Compose a small table directly from custom JSX rows and cells without data-driven sorting.
Show a simple sequence of items with only a few attributes.
Expand and collapse a parent-child hierarchy; this wrapper renders flat rows.
Collect fields for one object rather than compare repeated records.
